summary.text: Paul Lowe is a Democratic state senator from North Carolina who represents District 32, covering Forsyth County, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Peter Antinozzi and Green Party candidate Keenen Altic.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as clergy.

paragraphs.text: Lowe assumed office in the Senate on January 30, 2015, succeeding Earline Parmon, according to Ballotpedia.

The General Assembly's website shows his committee assignments in Appropriations on Agriculture, Natural, and Economic Resources; Appropriations/Base Budget; Commerce and Insurance; Elections; Finance; and Rules and Operations of the Senate.
Lowe advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
